mapper.sql: rx.id,rx.encounter_id,e.appointment_id,p.name AS patient_name,d.name AS doctor_name, dep.name AS department_name,rx.status,rx.total_amount,rx.version,rx.created_at,rx.issued_at

med_prescription rx JOIN med_encounter e ON e.id=rx.encounter_id JOIN med_appointment a ON a.id=e.appointment_id JOIN med_patient p ON p.id=a.patient_id JOIN med_doctor d ON d.id=e.doctor_id JOIN med_department dep ON dep.id=d.department_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM med_prescription WHERE encounter_id=#{encounterId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,code,name,specification,unit,unit_price,status FROM med_drug WHERE id=#{drugId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE med_prescription SET status='DRAFT',total_amount=#{total},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{prescriptionId} AND status IN ('DRAFT','DISCARDED') AND version=#{version}
UPDATE med_prescription SET status='DISCARDED',total_amount=0,version=version+1 WHERE id=#{prescriptionId} AND status='DRAFT' AND version=#{version}
UPDATE med_prescription SET status='ISSUED',issued_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{prescriptionId} AND status='DRAFT' AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT id,drug_id,drug_code,drug_name,specification,unit,quantity,instructions,unit_price,line_amount FROM med_prescription_item WHERE prescription_id=#{prescriptionId} ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM WHERE rx.id=#{prescriptionId} AND rx.status='ISSUED' AND p.owner_user_id=#{userId}
SELECT FROM med_bill WHERE prescription_id IN #{id}

SELECT b.id,b.prescription_id,b.status,b.total_amount,b.paid_at FROM med_bill b JOIN med_prescription rx ON rx.id=b.prescription_id JOIN med_encounter e ON e.id=rx.encounter_id JOIN med_appointment a ON a.id=e.appointment_id JOIN med_patient p ON p.id=a.patient_id WHERE b.id=#{billId} AND p.owner_user_id=#{userId} AND rx.status='ISSUED' FOR UPDATE OF b
mapper.update: UPDATE med_bill SET status='PAID',paid_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{billId} AND status='UNPAID'
